sehemu: Part III: Procedure, Powers and Privileges of Parliament
jina: Vacant seats in the National Assembly
maudhui: The National Assembly may transact business at its sittings notwithstanding that there is a vacancy among the seats of Members, whether the seat has been vacant since Parliament first met after a General Election or became vacant after that first meeting; and if any person not entitled to participate takes part in such business, or any person not entitled to be present is present during such business, that person's participation or presence shall not invalidate the proceedings.
